name: web-controls (proof of concept)
description: Calls web-controls functions on a live page from an extension popup. USGS gets its own manifest; any other site uses the zero-manifest GENERIC fallback, enabled per-site at runtime. Two model options for the real tool-calling: WebLLM (local, offscreen document, no cost, real download time) or Gemini's free tier (cloud, instant, needs an API key).
